name: Bizarre Tutor
text:
Search your library for a card, then shuffle and put that card on top.
Tire yourself (Put a Confusion card on top of your library. It's a colorless sorcery card with no mana cost that has cycling {2}.)

name: Compleat Mockery
text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, you lose 1 life and you create a token that's a copy of this enchantment.
{2}: Target opponent gains control of this enchantment. Activate only as a sorcery.
Sacrifice four enchantments named Compleat Mockery: Create a token that's a copy of target permanent. Activate only as a sorcery.

name: Two with Nothing
text:
Discard your hand. If this is the second time you cast a spell named Two with Nothing this turn, instead each player discards their hand.
